svg.title: Localswim V2 milestone workstreams
svg.desc: Six workstreams arranged from left to right. Thirty-nine milestones flow downward within each workstream. Parallel branches begin at the same height. Gold labels name cross-workstream prerequisites for the live demo, which do not prevent development against fixtures. Positions show order, not elapsed time.
svg.text: Read downward. Branches at the same height can be built in parallel with separate owners.
Cross-workstream demo gate · work may begin with fixtures

svg.text: Every 3 hours, demo the milestones that landed on the integrated build.
Aligned starts show parallel implementation. Arrows show order, not elapsed time. Gold labels preserve the cross-stream demo gates.
